title: Refuse a shape/merged gate approval over a plan.md whose load-bearing claims table is missing, malformed, or still guessing
action: Write plan_claims.rs (parser + rules + unit tests), wire plan_claims_refusal into set_gate.rs under its own shape/merge guard, add the integration tests, and keep the whole bee-rs suite green.

truths: bee state gate --name shape --approved true (or --merge) over a plan.md carrying a guessed row refuses, naming the row, the expected shape, and the remedy
bee state gate --name execution over the same plan.md does not fire the claims check
a lane with no plan.md approves exactly as before (NotFound is inapplicable, not a refusal)
an unreadable plan.md (directory fixture) refuses — fail-closed

description: New module plan_claims.rs: parser for the '## Load-bearing claims' markdown table + rule evaluation + ALL rule-level unit tests. A <=15-line wrapper plan_claims_refusal in set_gate.rs under its OWN guard `approved && (merge || name == "shape")` (never plain --name execution — plan is frozen post-shape, remedy impossible), running AFTER the existing preconditions in the merged path so their refusal-message tests stay stable. Feature selection copies M1 (lane approval -> lane's feature; default record -> its feature field; no target record -> inapplicable). Path: advisor_plan_path(root, feature) (advisor_ref.rs:78). Rules: ErrorKind::NotFound -> inapplicable; any other read error -> refuse (portable fixture: plan.md as a directory); heading absent -> refuse; zero rows -> refuse; row missing label/anchor/evidence -> refuse; label outside {read,ran,guessed} (exact, lowercase) -> refuse; any guessed row -> refuse; read-labeled row with a path:line anchor whose path is absent under root -> refuse. Refusal text: offending row numbers + expected shape (columns + label vocabulary) + remedy (upgrade the label with a real read/run, or move the claim to '## Open Questions'). Integration tests in set_gate's test module: full-verb --merge refusal on a real plan.md with a guessed row; --name shape fires; --name execution does not (pin); no-plan.md pass-through; --approved false never fires; update the one existing fixture that writes plan.md then approves --merge (set_gate.rs:1587-1600) if refusal ordering does not already keep it green. Full contract: docs/history/existence-is-not-evidence/plan.md (Approach + Shape cell 1).
